verdict.rationale: The pricing docs separate a free tier ($0 for local LoRA fine-tuning with the open-source package) from paid Platform tiers (Starter, Pro, Custom) that add hosted GPUs, full-model training, a confidence head and 2-bit exports. This shows which features cost money, but nothing addresses whether commercial or enterprise use of the free open-source package needs a paid license. missing for 10: the open-source license terms, an explicit statement on commercial/enterprise use rights, details of what the Custom/enterprise tier covers, and independent confirmation.
